summary: Anonymous storytelling & discussion platform (Genuine Being Real) where users submit real-life stories (optionally anonymous) via in-app form, stories are published/rewritten under pseudonyms, readers can comment/discuss, and the app includes an About Me section/page describing the creator and mission.
architectural_notes: Email-based story submission is not available; support story submissions directly in-app instead.
known_issues: Generated image assets use blue/light-blue colors; user indicates the image color palette is not acceptable and should be adjusted to the intended warm neutral/editorial palette.

existing_features.title: Build a frontend story submission flow: a page with a form to submit a real-life story, including fields for story text, optional name, and a clear toggle to submit anonymously; show a success confirmation state after submission.

Build the reader experience: a published story feed page and a story detail page that displays the pseudonym, published content, and comment thread; include a comment composer that lets readers post comments with an optional display name.
Create an admin/moderation UI for the authorized principal to: view incoming submissions, enter rewritten/published title and body, set a pseudonym, and publish the story.

Apply a coherent visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for an anonymous storytelling platform; use a warm editorial style (paper-like background, dark neutral text, subtle accent color) and keep it consistent across all pages and states.

Add static generated image assets and render them in the UI: include a simple wordmark/logo and a subtle header/hero illustration consistent with the editorial theme; store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

Update the app’s generated image assets to remove blue/light-blue tones and replace them with a warm neutral, editorial palette (off-white paper, warm grays, ink/charcoal), then update the frontend to reference the updated image filenames wherever they are used (header wordmark and feed hero image).
Create a new About page that displays the provided “About Me” bio/mission text for Genuine Being Real, including the debut novel mention (“Shining Gaze – A Search for the Unknown”).
Add an /about route to the TanStack Router configuration and wire it to the new About page component.
Add a visible navigation entry point to the About page from the global layout footer (and keep existing footer content intact).

new_feature_requests.summary: Publish/rewrite submitted stories under pseudonyms/different names

Create backend data models and stable storage for story submissions, published stories, and comments, including fields for: submission content, optional submitter name (or explicit anonymous flag), created timestamps, published pseudonym, published title/body (rewritten text), and per-story comment threads.

Implement backend APIs to: (1) create a story submission, (2) list submitted stories for moderation, (3) publish a story under a pseudonym with rewritten/public text, (4) list published stories (with pagination or sensible limits), (5) fetch a single published story with its comments, and (6) add a comment to a published story.

Add a simple moderation/admin gate for rewriting/publishing actions so only an authorized principal (configured in backend) can list submissions and publish/rewrite stories; anonymous/public users can only view published stories and add comments.
Add an About Me page/section with the provided creator bio/mission text (Genuine Being Real, debut novel mention) and link it from the app (e.g., footer/nav).
